ideas.title: Grow Herbs for Potions 🌿
ideas.hook: Plant magic herbs in your witch garden, let them mutate into rare colours, and brew them into potions that give you powers in the village.
core_loop: Plant herb seeds in your garden plot
Water and wait for growth (mutations can appear)
Harvest and add new herbs to your herb book
Brew potions and sell them to villagers
Buy rarer seeds and a bigger cauldron
ideas.twist: Every potion you brew also works on you: drink a rare one to fly, shrink or glow for a few minutes and reach hidden herb patches.
retention: Weekly rare seed in the shop
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is the top rising mechanic at 1.97 (up 0.40 this week, 54 new games, 122,348 CCU), led by Throw a Seed (32,553) and Ant Evolution (18,568). Collect / index + Grow / farm is a live pair (7 new games, 39,902 CCU), and Fantasy / medieval is rising at 1.73, up 0.64 this week (Kit PVP FFA 11,312, Dragon Arena 6,945).
ideas.differentiator: Farming games sell crops for cash; here the harvest turns into powers that open new parts of the map.

ideas.title: +1 Lantern Light 🏮
ideas.hook: You are lost in a pitch-black mine. Every step makes your lantern +1 brighter, and the brighter it gets, the deeper you can go before the dark catches you.
core_loop: Walk to gain +1 light per step
Push into darker tunnels
Grab ore shining at the edge of your light
Run back to camp before the dark creature reaches you
Rebirth for a light multiplier
ideas.twist: The thing in the dark is scared of light: once your lantern is bright enough you can chase it back and claim its tunnel.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.73 (44 new games, 68,209 CCU) and the "+1 ___" title formula is at 1.76 with 38 new games ([UPD🧬] +1 Venom Evolution 8,473, +1 Boxing Battle Evolution 3,971). Interior maps are the top rising map style at 1.91 (NIGHT WITH OPAH 28,265), and new +1 games are adding scary twists (vision: [W3] +1 Scary Evolution).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games pump a number for its own sake; here the stat is the light itself, so growing it changes what you can see and where you can go.

ideas.title: Pull Cards for Bot Parts 🃏
ideas.hook: Open card packs to get robot parts — heads, arms, legs, cores — snap them onto your bot and send it into the arena.
core_loop: Open a card pack with coins
Equip the part cards on your robot
Battle other players' bots
Win coins and pack tokens
Fuse duplicate cards into higher rarity
ideas.twist: Parts from the same set give a set bonus, so players trade single cards to finish a full legendary set.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards + Robots / mechs is an open gap (score 3.24). Robots / mechs is rising at 1.91, up 0.28 this week (untitled ragdoll game 9,011, RoChess! 4,193), and Dice / cards is at 1.24, up 0.28, led by My Little Pony Card Opening (8,307).
ideas.differentiator: Card games here collect characters; cards that build a robot you then fight with are not in the tracked games.

ideas.title: Hammer Kart 🔨
ideas.hook: Kart racing where every driver has a giant hammer. Swing it to flip rivals off the track and ragdoll them into the barriers.
core_loop: Join a race lobby
Drive and swing at karts next to you
Each knockout fills your boost
Finish for coins
Buy bigger hammers and faster karts
ideas.twist: Hitting the ground with a full swing launches your own kart over shortcuts, so the hammer is also your jump.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch + Race / drive is the biggest pair in the data (9 new games, 78,289 CCU). Hit / swing is rising at 1.84 (227,949 CCU in new games) and the Physics Sim subgenre is at 2.71 (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll 47,752, BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 20,414).
ideas.differentiator: Kart games have items and guns; a hammer you aim yourself with ragdoll knockouts is a simple skill hook none of them use.

ideas.title: Survive the Space Station 🛸
ideas.hook: You and your crew are stuck on a broken space station. Fix the rooms by day, then fight off the aliens crawling through the vents at night.
core_loop: Repair rooms to restore power and oxygen
Craft tools into weapons
Hold the corridors when the lights go out
Survive the night to earn parts
Unlock new station wings
ideas.twist: Every room you repair is also a room the aliens can reach, so the crew must choose what to fix and what to seal off.
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Survive is a strong pair (12 new games, 71,745 CCU). Interior maps are the top rising map style at 1.91 (NIGHT WITH OPAH 28,265, Warnetopia: Internet Cafe 11,447), and Space is rising at 2.43 ([🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 5,312) — space has low confidence, so the interior survival loop carries it.
ideas.differentiator: Survival-night games are set in houses and forests; a station where repairs open new attack routes adds a real choice each night.

ideas.title: Don't Dig Too Deep 🧟
ideas.hook: Dig your mine shaft for treasure, but the deeper you go, the more zombies climb up out of it at night.
core_loop: Dig down and collect ore by day
Sell ore and upgrade your shovel
Build barricades around your shaft
Fight off zombies that climb up at night
Dig deeper for rarer ore
ideas.twist: Deeper layers have better ore but more zombies, so players choose how greedy to be each day.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Zombies is an open gap (score 2.5). Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.48 (50 new games, 116,229 CCU; [WORLD 2] Sandworm Playground 9,051), and the Escape subgenre is at 1.53 (13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] 11,087).
ideas.differentiator: Dig games have no danger, and zombie games have no digging; tying the zombie count to how deep you dig makes every shovel swing a risk.

ideas.title: Snipe Supply Drops 🪂
ideas.hook: Supply crates parachute across the sky. Shoot the chute to drop the crate, then race other players to grab what's inside.
core_loop: Spot falling crates
Shoot the parachute
Run to the crate before others
Open it for gear and cash
Upgrade your rifle and scope
ideas.twist: Golden crates fall fast and high, so only upgraded scopes can hit them in time.
ideas.why_now: Military / war is rising at 1.75, up 0.50 this week, led by Voxel Wars (17,542). Shooter is rising at 1.51 (45 new games, 186,236 CCU; [🏹] Shoot Arrows For Animals! 17,061) and voxel / blocky art is the top rising style at 2.52.
ideas.differentiator: Sniper games aim at players; shooting loot out of the sky is a calm, quick loop with no PvP needed.

ideas.title: +1 Turret Per Lap 🏎️
ideas.hook: Every lap you finish bolts one more turret onto your car. By lap ten you're a rolling fortress shooting everyone around you.
core_loop: Race laps on the track
Gain +1 turret each lap
Shoot rivals to slow them
Win races for parts
Upgrade turret types and car armor
ideas.twist: More turrets make your car heavier and slower, so leaders get weaker on speed while chasers can catch up.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive + Shooter is a top pair (7 new games, 69,557 CCU). Shooter is rising at 1.51 and Race / drive at 1.23 (BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 20,414); the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.76 with 38 new games.
ideas.differentiator: No tracked racer grows your weapons every lap; the weight trade-off keeps races close.

ideas.title: Pirate Fort Tycoon 🏴‍☠️
ideas.hook: Build a pirate fort on your own island, fill it with cannons and crew, then sail out to raid other players' forts.
core_loop: Collect gold from your docks
Build walls, cannons and crew huts
Defend against raids
Sail to raid other forts
Spend loot on a bigger ship
ideas.twist: Captured enemy cannons can be mounted on your own walls, so a good raid upgrades your defense.
ideas.why_now: The "___ Tycoon" formula is up 0.47 this week to 1.09 (LINE UP! Metro Tycoon 6,405, (🚨) Prison Tycoon 6,022), and Fight / battle + Tycoon is the most crowded live pair (16 new games, 36,454 CCU). Ocean / pirates is rising at 1.34 ([🏝️ISLAND] Criminal Simulator 💰 11,996).
ideas.differentiator: Pirate games are sailing or fishing; a tycoon where you raid other players' forts gives the tycoon a fight loop.

ideas.title: Smash Golems for Gems 🗿
ideas.hook: Rock golems roam the canyon. Smash them apart with your pickaxe and grab the gems hidden in their bodies.
core_loop: Find a golem
Hit it until it cracks
Collect gems from the pieces
Sell gems for a better pickaxe
Move to zones with bigger golems
ideas.twist: Golems that lose a fight rebuild bigger from nearby rocks, so leaving pieces behind makes the next one harder.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Fight / battle is a live pair (7 new games, 52,749 CCU). Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.48 and Fight / battle at 1.22, up 0.10 (Half Punch, [🦃] Defeat Ragdolls for Powers! 5,883).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games break still rocks; here the rock fights back and rebuilds, turning mining into boss fights.
